THIS IS NO LONGER BETA, FILES COMPLETE AS RELEASED. 

These frames are designed to turn your original Shield parts kits back into functional firearms. YAY!
The main frame was edited from the gatalog release by FMDA (Thanks FMDA you're the GOAT)
Also, big thanks to OA for helping with the 7rd magazine baseplate!

The final revision includes a redesigned magazine catch area for easier mag ejection as well as some small ergonomic tweaks to make it easier to print multi material. Also including a 7 round magazine baseplate
